svg.text: CVA6 Suite 10: Unaligned Halfword Traps & MRET Pipeline Resumption
Phases 4 & 5: LH from 0x80000403 and SH to 0x80000401 showing hardware fault isolation and resume flow

g.text: • Unaligned Halfword Load (0x80000403): In Cycle 483, LH from odd address triggers data_misaligned=1. mtval records 0x80000403 and ISR handles the trap.
• Unaligned Halfword Store (0x80000401): In Cycle 534, SH to odd address triggers data_misaligned=1. Cause 6 (ST_ADDR_MISALIGNED) and mtval=0x80000401 are recorded.
• Terminal Completion: All 4 traps successfully recovered. The benchmark executes its final completion marker ra=999 at cycle 578 and enters the terminal loop with 0 errors.
